findings.description: The title says headers moves back to Mapping, but the diff also changes the value type from `str | bytes` to `object`, which the title does not announce. `Mapping[str, object]` is looser than the old `MutableMapping[str, str | bytes]` value type.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller passes headers containing non-str/bytes values such as ints or None. These now pass type checking, but header validation at runtime rejects them (`check_header_validity` raises InvalidHeader for non-str/bytes values). Impact: type errors that used to be caught statically now surface as runtime failures.
